description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama, Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in the Aluthgama Bogamuwa area. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
